title: Olivia Rodrigo · the cure
description: Crimson-yarn title tray, mint hospital corridor with pink O R doors, glowing glass chemistry lab, ribcage X-ray frame with pulsing heart, corridor acoustic guitar & mic, green ECG monitors, overhead pink bed tangled in crimson yarn, and sunlit miniature dollhouse reveal.
